options.content:
### Kyverno — chart dashboard (kyverno chart 3.10.0)
Upstream dashboard kept for reference; the day-to-day view is **Kyverno** (curated). In this lab the *fail* results are
**audit findings** of the 12 Pod Security Standards baseline ValidatingPolicies (Audit mode, nothing is blocked), the only
MutatingPolicy is `pod-zone-label` and the only GeneratingPolicy is `mcp-read-crds`. *Enforcing (Deny) Validating
Policies* stays empty until a policy is moved to Enforce. Removed: ImageValidatingPolicy and DeletingPolicy panels (no such
policies here). Docs: [Kyverno metrics](https://kyverno.io/docs/reference/metrics/), `docs/dashboards/security.md`.

# Kyverno
A Kubernetes-native policy management engine

#### About this dashboard

This dashboard represents generic insights that can be extracted from a cluster with Kyverno running.

- **Policies (policies.kyverno.io)** rows cover `ValidatingPolicy`, `ImageValidatingPolicy`, `MutatingPolicy`, `GeneratingPolicy`, `DeletingPolicy` and their namespaced variants.

#### For more details around the metrics

Checkout the [official docs of Kyverno metrics](https://kyverno.io/docs/monitoring/)

panels.description: Upstream description of this dashboard.

Percentage of fail results across ValidatingPolicy, ImageValidatingPolicy, MutatingPolicy and GeneratingPolicy evaluations (admission and background) in the last 24 hours. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
(sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
or vector(0)) * 100
/
sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Policy Failure Rate (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy and NamespacedValidatingPolicy resources evaluated in the selected time range. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Validating Policies

panels.description: MutatingPolicy and NamespacedMutatingPolicy resources evaluated in the selected time range. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total[$__range])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Mutating Policies

panels.description: GeneratingPolicy and NamespacedGeneratingPolicy resources evaluated in the selected time range. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total[$__range])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Generating Policies

panels.description: Percentage of fail results produced by background scans (reports controller, and GeneratingPolicy evaluations in the background controller) in the last 24 hours. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
(sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
or vector(0)) * 100
/
sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Background Scan Failure Rate (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy and ImageValidatingPolicy resources with the Deny validation action. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Deny"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Deny"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Enforcing (Deny) Validating Policies

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy and ImageValidatingPolicy resources without the Deny validation action. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Audit"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Audit"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Audit-only Validating Policies

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy, ImageValidatingPolicy and MutatingPolicy resources with background processing enabled. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{policy_background_mode="true"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{policy_background_mode="true"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{policy_background_mode="true"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Background-enabled Policies

panels.description: Results of ValidatingPolicy, ImageValidatingPolicy and MutatingPolicy evaluations during admission review, per 5 minutes. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (result) (
  label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Admission Review Results

panels.description: Results of policy evaluations during background processing (reports controller scans and GeneratingPolicy evaluations), per 5 minutes. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (result) (
  label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Background Scan Results

panels.description: Fail results per 5 minutes, split by policy kind. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Policy Failures (by policy kind)

panels.description: Admission review results per policy, per 5 minutes. Cluster-scoped policies are shown with namespace '-'. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

panels.title: Admission Review Results (per-policy)

panels.description: Background processing results per policy, per 5 minutes. Cluster-scoped policies are shown with namespace '-'. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

panels.title: Background Scan Results (per-policy)

panels.description: Policies with the most fail results in the last 24 hours. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
topk(10,
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

panels.title: Top 10 Failing Policies (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: Resource kinds that received the most fail results in the last 24 hours, across all policy kinds.

targets.expr:
topk(10,
sum by (resource_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Top 10 Resource Kinds with Failures (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: Average time spent evaluating a single policy against a resource, over 5 minute windows. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
/
sum by (policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Average Policy Execution Latency (by policy kind)

panels.description: 95th percentile time spent evaluating a single policy against a resource, over 5 minute windows. Accuracy depends on the configured histogram bucket boundaries. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.95,
sum by (le, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
)

panels.title: p95 Policy Execution Latency (by policy kind)

panels.description: Average policy execution latency across all policies.kyverno.io kinds in the selected time range.

targets.expr:
sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[$__range])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[$__range])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
/
sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[$__range])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[$__range])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Average Policy Execution Latency

panels.description: 95th percentile policy execution latency across all policies.kyverno.io kinds in the selected time range.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.95,
sum by (le) (
  label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
)

panels.title: p95 Policy Execution Latency

panels.description: Average execution latency per policy, over 5 minute windows.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[5m]))
/
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[5m])),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[5m]))
/
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[5m])),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum[5m]))
/
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count[5m])),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

panels.title: Average Policy Execution Latency (per-policy)

targets.expr: sum(rate(kyverno_admission_review_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) by (resource_request_operation) / sum(rate(kyverno_admission_review_duration_seconds_count[5m])) by (resource_request_operation)

panels.title: Avg - Admission Review Duration Over Time (by operation)
panels.description: Average admission review time (sum/count of kyverno_admission_review_duration_seconds) per operation (create/update/delete). Averages hide spikes: see the p99 in the curated Kyverno dashboard.

targets.expr: sum(rate(kyverno_admission_review_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) by (resource_kind) / sum(rate(kyverno_admission_review_duration_seconds_count[5m])) by (resource_kind)

panels.title: Avg - Admission Review Duration Over Time (by resource kind)
panels.description: Average admission review time per resource kind.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kyverno_admission_requests_total[5m]))

panels.title: Rate - Incoming Admission Requests (per 5m)
panels.description: Admission requests received in the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum(kyverno_admission_review_duration_seconds_sum)/sum(kyverno_admission_review_duration_seconds_count)

panels.title: Avg - Overall Admission Review Duration
panels.description: Average admission review time since the admission controller started (cumulative sum/count).

targets.expr: sum(increase(kyverno_admission_requests_total[5m])) by (resource_request_operation)

panels.title: Admission Requests (by operation)
panels.description: Admission requests per 5 minutes by operation.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kyverno_admission_requests_total[5m])) by (resource_kind)

panels.title: Admission Requests (by resource kind)
panels.description: Admission requests per 5 minutes by resource kind.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kyverno_admission_requests_total[24h]))

panels.title: Total Admission Requests (Last 24 Hours)
panels.description: Admission requests received in the last 24 hours.

title: Kyverno (official)
